summary.text: Mark Zimmer is the Republican candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 150 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Alexandros Orestis.
Ballotpedia lists him as retired and a 1981 graduate of Lehigh University.

paragraphs.text: In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Zimmer said he was born in a suburb of Philadelphia, worked summer jobs including time as a merchant mariner and on a tree-service crew, and graduated from Lehigh University with degrees in economics and finance.
He said he then worked on Wall Street, and described himself as a financial problem solver who wants to reduce the tax burden while improving infrastructure.
Zimmer advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
